summary: Uses Stype/RedSpy tracker channels to apply simulated lens distortion to an input image.

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: CHOP containing Stype lens distortion channels.

key_params.name: padding
key_params.note: Crop/correct for padding when the source is not a Stype CHOP.

common_gotchas: Custom CHOP sources need exact channel names: k1, k2, centerx, centery, pawidth, paheight.
Padding is only enabled when the referenced CHOP is not a Stype CHOP.
The official page says “This CHOP works” even though the operator is a TOP.
key_concepts: Stype TOP is a Pro-only TOP for Stype/RedSpy camera-tracker lens distortion workflows.
The TOP is driven by a CHOP, usually Stype CHOP.
Custom CHOP sources must provide k1, k2, centerx, centery, pawidth, and paheight channels.
Padding correction is only enabled when the CHOP source is not a Stype CHOP.
